Name: Expanded Starter Package
Author: tbonehunter
Description:
Allows configuration of the game's starter package without having to edit text files (or understand the coding involved) to add items. Easy interface accessed from the title screen gear icon (GMCM menu). Configure the number of items allowable to fit your backpack (vanilla is 7 items after the tools are added) without losing any due to overflow. Allows you to configure more for larger backpacks. Select from dropdown list, search by category or use the "search all" input bar to find the items you want to add. Allows you to change quantities and quality for items that support that (eg, "Big Chest" allows selection of quantity but not quality, "Cauliflower" allows selection of both quality and quantity.) Add weapons, rings, trinkets, craftables, or any of the selectable 2,182 items in the game. Comes with data from vanilla game preloaded.

This mod is a successor to Custom Starter Package Builder, a standalone package that doesn't run within the game, and was restricted to Windows/PC use as I didn't have a Mac or Linux build. Running the mod in-game allows it to be platform-agnostic and just run wherever SV does.

Downloads.Description: Customize the items you receive when starting a new game. Supports all vanilla items and respects quantity/quality attributes. Version 1.1.0 adds the options of Add or Merge, to allow the mod to work with other starter package mods.
